zh-a.text: 大家好！今天想跟你们分享一个超好用的实验室小工具，真的能帮你省下好多时间。
zh-a.designed_from: 二十多岁的年轻女生，声音明亮、清脆、有活力，语速稍快，带着笑意，像在给朋友安利好东西的科普博主，普通话标准。

en-b.text: Hi everyone! Today I want to share a really handy little tool for the lab. It honestly saves so much time.
en-b.designed_from: A young female voice, warm and friendly but full of energy, crisp diction, lively rhythm, like an enthusiastic PhD student explaining something she loves. Neutral American accent.
